bancode.role: Unrecoverable critical panics, hardware faults, fatal exceptions. May be printable; useful when showing the glyph of the error, not just its codename or codepoint.

warncode.role: Non-fatal telemetry; threshold alerts, degraded performance, predictive maintenance. May be printable; useful when showing the glyph of the error, not just its codename or codepoint.

comcode.role: IPC events, bus orchestration, hardware handshakes, driver attachment, control plane signals; also success reports. May be printable; useful when showing the glyph of the error, not just its codename or codepoint.

softcode.role: Soft recovery, fault containment, cache reconciliation, self-healing routines; also soft errors. May be printable; useful when showing the glyph of the error, not just its codename or codepoint.
